recipes.name: workenv.ensure
recipes.description: Reserve one worker at a time and run bootstrap health or reconciliation without claiming authentication success.

recipes.name: workenv.claim
recipes.description: Atomically reserve an eligible worker on the controller, then claim the exact remote task identity and revision.

recipes.name: workenv.record-runtime
recipes.description: Record exact APoC and Herdr runtime IDs against the active remote task before release checks.

recipes.name: workenv.status
recipes.description: Read central APoC worker reservations and remote worker status without changing task ownership.

recipes.name: workenv.collect
recipes.description: Collect one claimed task, retrieve the remote collection, and verify the local copy before returning.

recipes.name: workenv.release
recipes.description: Release one worker only after a matching verified local collection and no live tracked task activity.
